name: ONF Flat One+ 60
description: Design-led app-controlled bar light for 60 cm planted tanks with touch dimming and programmable schedules. ONF publishes 4,500 lm, a 110-degree beam, and a 613 mm housing for the 60 cm model. light.colorTempK records the mid-point (4750) of the yellow/white variant's published 3,000-6,500K adjustable range (the blue/white variant spans 6,500-20,500K instead). coverageLitres is an approximate window for the 60 cm tank class the fixture is sold for; ONF publishes tank length, not volume.
